The '''Hiitite Ravagers''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that once threatened [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]], but were beaten back by the efforts of the [[Trianii Rangers]].

They originated from the [[Hiit system/Legends|Hiit system]] and were composed of [[Hiitian/Legends|Hiitians]].
